This file documents the counterparty_aliases resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =counterparty_aliases=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 1DD8B29C-1402-5AFA-9CFE-2B27D3632BE0
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
counterparty_aliases list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =dq.v1.counterparty_aliases.list=.

#+name: counterparty_aliases-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle counterparty_aliases-list.ores :exports none
counterparty_aliases list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 5636471F-F6A6-5066-883E-69D7086611EC

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example

#+end_example

It is addressed at =dq.v1.counterparty_aliases.get=.

#+name: counterparty_aliases-get
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle counterparty_aliases-get.ores :exports none
counterparty_aliases get __none__
#+end_src
